rules.objectsInvalid: Objects per frame must be a whole number from 0.
rules.scaleInvalid: Object scale must be a number above 0.
rules.objectsHint: 0 objects — backgrounds only, without annotation. Scale 1 — an object can fill the whole frame.
rules.emptyHint: This share of frames stays without objects — it teaches the model not to find objects on an empty background.
rules.seedInvalid: Advanced: seed must be a whole number from 0 to 4,294,967,295.
rules.repeatHint: Shares, variants and size come from the run snapshot. Deleted and archived sources may prevent saving.
rules.cancelled: Generation was cancelled. Saved results are available if the result group was kept.
rules.interrupted: Generation was interrupted by closing the application. Saved results are available if the result group was kept.

form.repeatNotice: The settings of the saved run were copied to the form. Save a new preset and run it.
form.setSizeMismatch: The set size {{setWidth}} × {{setHeight}} does not match the frame {{width}} × {{height}}: this set does not fit generation.
form.intro: Choose backgrounds and variant shares. The recipe keeps these rules for future runs.
form.name: Name
form.setMissing: The set was deleted or is unavailable
form.sharesHint: Choose the share of each variant among objects. The sum must be 100%. At 0% a variant is not used.
form.noVariants: Register project variants, then add classes and images.
form.canvasNote: Generation needs images with a transparent background. Objects larger than the input image are scaled down; the scale sets their largest share of the frame. Result size: <size>{{width}} × {{height}}</size>.

fields.backgroundSetIds: Choose at least one background set.
fields.classVariantIds: At least one variant with images and a share above 0% is needed.
fields.variantWeights: Variant shares must add up to 100%.

launch.title: Run parameters
launch.seedHint: The seed is chosen at random on opening; enter an earlier one to repeat a run. The same seed gives the same result: the sample frame shows the first frames of the run.
launch.note: Each run creates a separate group. The recipe and the sources are fixed at the start of the run.

deletion.failed: Could not delete. Refresh the list and repeat the action.
deletion.runTitle: Delete the run from the history?
deletion.recipeText: {{name}}. The preset settings will be deleted. The run history, its saved settings and images stay. The record cannot be restored in the application.
deletion.runText: {{name}}. The run record and its settings will be deleted. The created group, images and annotation stay. The record cannot be restored in the application.
